title: Ordinary derived tensor preserves the geometric open support
statement: Fix k₀,l,U,Z,j as in the native open tensor data [def-sf-native-open-tensor-operations]. Write E′ for the exact derived ordinary adic extension by zero on the geometric open, R′ for exact derived ordinary restriction, and a′ for their localized sheaf adjunction. Let TB′ be the fixed ambient ordinary derived tensor in nativeDerivedClosedComparison [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful]. For every ordinary derived object M on U and N on Z, the counit a′.counit at TB′(E′ M,N) is an isomorphism. This only asserts support, with no chosen projection map, native presentation, Frobenius structure, or forgetting square.

proof.text: Apply nativeOrdinary_tensorRight_iso to the ordinary Hom representatives of nativeDerivedClosedComparison. This identifies its fixed tensor, with the same input order, with the canonical derived module tensor. No ordinary tensor representative choices or normalization equations are needed.

For an ordinary module sheaf vanishing on the closed complement of the geometric open, the open counit is an isomorphism. Pullback to the open is invertible by the right triangle identity and the invertible open unit; pullback to the complement has zero source and target by disjoint extension vanishing. The existing source theorem ProEtale.isIso_of_forall_isIso_adicUpperStar_map detects invertibility using these two quasi-compact maps. The geometric open is quasi-compact in the existing finite-type setting. The existing adicUpperStarTensorLeftIso and the proved relative-tensor coequalizer comparison show that an extended sheaf tensored with any ambient sheaf vanishes on the complement. Thus it belongs to the essential image of extension. These are the private proved helpers ordinary_supported_of_complement_zero and ordinary_sheaf_tensor_supported.

proof.text: Use closure of the fully faithful extension essential image under preserved coproducts and GradedObject.isColimitCofanMapObj to show every total-tensor term is supported. The open counit is a termwise isomorphism of complexes. Its localization and mapDerivedCategoryFactors provide an explicit essential-image witness for the localized total complex. Choose a K-flat homotopy-category representative for the ambient input by DerivedCategory.exists_kFlat_iso, represent the open input by a complex, and apply the invertible canonical localization tensorator. This proves support for the canonical derived tensor and then for the fixed ordinary tensor via the first comparison. The argument is the private proved helpers ordinary_total_tensor_supported, ordinary_Q_supported and ordinary_derived_tensor_supported.

proof.text: Localize the inverse ordinary open unit using the standard exact-functor composition and identity comparisons. This proves full faithfulness of the exact derived extension for the specified adjunction mapExactDerivedCategory. Apply Adjunction.isIso_counit_app_iff_mem_essImage to the supported tensor. No compatibility between this adjunction and another chosen derived adjunction is needed.

theorem native_ordinary_open_tensor_support
    (M : DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l
      (U ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber))
    (N : DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l
      (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)) :
    IsIso ((ProEtale.adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction l
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).mapExactDerivedCategory.counit.app
        ((nativeDerivedClosedComparison k₀ l Z).ordinaryClosed.tensor.obj
          ((ProEtale.adicOpenImmersionLowerShriek l
            (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).mapDerivedCategory.obj M, N)))
